description: Official list of UK border control posts (BCPs) for live animals, products of animal origin and high-risk food and feed of non-animal origin, from GOV.UK (Defra/APHA): BCP code, port or airport, approved categories (POA, PNAO, live animals, with HC/NHC and temperature specs), extra scope limits, address, inspection centre, email, phone and opening times. UK only (GB and Northern Ireland), not the EU list. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional category prefix, e.g. POA-HC, PNAO-NHC, LA-U

name.description: Optional text in the BCP name, e.g. Felixstowe
